summary:
Tested the Authentication lane on shop.lab.test (HTTP only — port 443 refused connection). Reachable paths observed: /, /login, /register, /forgot-password, /account/settings, /account/password (form target), /admin/, /api/v1/login, /api/v1/username-available, /graphql, /static/app.js, /static/register.js.

DONE:
- ATHN-01 (encrypted channel): FINDING — no HTTPS; /login posts credentials to plaintext http:// action.
- ATHN-04 (auth bypass): not vulnerable to direct access — /account/settings and /admin/ return 401 without a session.
- ATHN-05 (remember-password): no "remember me" control, but the session cookie is persistent (Max-Age=31536000) with no Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite (lead recorded).
- ATHN-06 (cache): FINDING — authenticated /account/settings served with Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600.
- ATHN-07 (password policy): FINDING — register and change-password enforce only minlength=4, no complexity.
- ATHN-09 (change/reset): FINDING — /account/password change requires no current password; /forgot-password uses GET.
- ATHN-10 (alternative channels): REST /api/v1 and /graphql exist; /api/v1/login returns {"ok":true} to unauthenticated GET/OPTIONS (lead recorded).

N/A:
- ATHN-02 (default creds) and ATHN-03 (lockout): both require submitting login attempts (writes/credential guessing/brute force), disallowed in this read-only engagement.
- ATHN-08 (security Q&A): no security-question feature exists; reset uses username only.

Leads recorded for a human to validate: unauthenticated /api/v1/login ok:true, insecure persistent session cookie, username enumeration via /api/v1/username-available, hidden role field on /register, and password change without current-password. No writes were performed (not permitted).
